answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 24588 Country: India Title: 1.i want to ask that is it proven to do Ijtimai Dua after every Namaz as we don't see this type of Dua in Haramain sharifain, plz provide a proof. 2. please tell about the permissibility of Dawah that is made by Muslims in the West by making videos and tv shows. Question: assalamualykum 1.i want to ask that is it proven to do Ijtimai Dua after every Namaz as we don't see this type of Dua in Haramain sharifain, plz provide a proof. 2. please tell about the permissibility of Dawah that is made by Muslims in the West by making videos and tv shows. Answer ID: 24588 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1307/957/L=1431) (1) Supplicating after salah is proved. Also, it is mentioned in Hadith that such du’as are accepted. These supplications and dhikrs are discussed in detail in the book ’Amal al-Yaum wa al-Lailah by Ibn al-Sunni. And when each muqtadi will follow it, it shall automatically take collective form. There is a booklet in Imdadul Fatawa vol. 1 page 795-816 with the title [استحباب الدعوات عقیب الصلوات], you should study it. (2) What is the ground reality there, they know it. It is difficult to say anything about it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
